description: Regularly occurring events in San Francisco (weekly / monthly / seasonal recurring schedules). Every row verified against the linked official source on the snapshot date.

events.name: Ferry Plaza Farmers Market
flags: Minor discrepancy: SF Travel's Ferry Building guide lists Tuesday hours as 8am; Foodwise (the operator) lists Tue & Thu 10am-2pm. Operator site used.
events.notes: California certified farmers market with 100+ vendors on Saturdays.

events.name: Heart of the City Farmers Market
events.location: Fulton Plaza, Civic Center (between SF Public Library and Asian Art Museum)
events.organizer: Heart of the City Farmers Market (independent farmer-operated nonprofit)
events.source_name: Heart of the City Farmers Market (official site)
events.notes: Founded 1981; relocated by the City from United Nations Plaza to Fulton Plaza in 2024.

events.name: Alemany Farmers Market
events.notes: Known as 'the People's Market'; dates to 1943 and is described by the City as California's oldest farmers market.

events.name: Mission Community Market
events.dates_2026: Seasonal mid-March to mid-November: Thu 3-7pm (2026 season opened March 19)
events.notes: Founded 2010; supports ~25 small farms and businesses.

events.name: Inner Sunset Farmers Market
events.location: 1315 8th Ave (parking lot between 8th & 9th Ave, off Irving St)

events.name: Stonestown Farmers Market
events.location: 501 Buckingham Way (Stonestown Galleria northwest parking lot)
events.notes: Formerly operated by PCFMA; now one of AIM's nine markets.

events.name: Castro Farmers Market
events.notes: Season (April-November) per PCFMA partner listings.

events.name: Divisadero Farmers Market
events.location: 1377 Fell St (DMV lot at Fell & Broderick)

events.name: Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile
events.source_name: SF Department of the Environment (City of San Francisco)
events.notes: Listed on the City's official farmers market directory.

events.name: Fort Mason Night Market with Off the Grid
events.dates_2026: Fridays 5-10pm; 2026 dates announced: Apr 17, May 22, Jun 19, Jul 24, Aug 21, Sep 18, Oct 16; additional Oct-Dec dates TBA
events.location: Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture, 2 Marina Blvd
events.organizer: Off the Grid, in partnership with Fort Mason Center, Stern Grove Festival and West Coast Craft
events.notes: Now a monthly Friday night market (25+ food trucks, 50+ craft vendors, live music); historically ran weekly.

events.name: Presidio Picnic
events.dates_2026: Sundays 11am-4pm, Main Parade Ground (seasonal spring-fall; 2026 season end date not stated on the page consulted)
events.location: Main Parade Ground, Presidio of San Francisco
flags: Exact 2026 season start/end dates not captured from the official announcement; schedule confirmed as Sundays on the Main Parade Ground.
events.notes: San Francisco's largest weekly community picnic; food trucks, games, yoga.

events.name: Presidio Twilight
events.location: Main Parade Ground, Presidio of San Francisco
events.organizer: Presidio Trust and Off the Grid
flags: Exact 2026 season start/end dates not captured from the official announcement; Thursday schedule confirmed by the Presidio Trust's 2026 summer lineup.
events.notes: Companion event to Presidio Picnic: food, live music, lantern-lit cabanas and fire pits.

events.name: NightLife at the California Academy of Sciences
events.location: California Academy of Sciences, Golden Gate Park
events.notes: Weekly after-hours exhibits, music, cocktails and programming; some dates excluded per the Academy.

events.name: San Francisco City Guides Walking Tours
events.organizer: San Francisco City Guides (nonprofit; a program of the San Francisco Public Library)
events.notes: Founded 1978; 300+ trained volunteer guides.

events.name: Free Programs in Union Square Plaza
events.dates_2026: Year-round weekly activities: chess lessons, live music, crafts, juggling; special cultural activities every second Saturday
events.source_name: Visit Union Square SF (Union Square Alliance)
events.notes: Listed in SF Travel's official monthly event guides.

events.name: Sunday Streets SF
events.dates_2026: 2026 season (18th): Jun 14 Tenderloin, Jul 19 Mission, Aug 23 Bayview, Oct 18 Excelsior
events.location: Rotating neighborhoods (2026: Tenderloin, Mission, Bayview, Excelsior)
events.organizer: Livable City, with SFMTA and City agency support
events.notes: Since 2008; streets closed to cars for recreation and community programs.

events.name: Critical Mass Bicycle Ride
events.dates_2026: Last Friday of each month; meet 5:30pm, roll 6:30pm from Embarcadero Plaza (next ride per official community site: Oct 30, 2026)
events.organizer: None (leaderless community ride, started in SF in 1992)
flags: No official organizer exists; the linked community site is the de facto information source. Route is not fixed.
events.notes: Founded September 1992 in San Francisco; spread to hundreds of cities worldwide.

events.name: Free First Tuesdays at the de Young & Legion of Honor
events.dates_2026: First Tuesday of each month, 9:30am-5:15pm (not during Bouquets to Art week)
events.location: de Young Museum & Legion of Honor
events.organizer: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (FAMSF)
events.source_name: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (official site)
events.notes: Free general admission to permanent collections for all visitors on first Tuesdays; free Saturdays for Bay Area residents (9 counties) also available.

events.name: Free First Sundays at the Asian Art Museum
events.dates_2026: First Sunday of each month (general admission free; special exhibitions discounted)
events.organizer: Asian Art Museum of San Francisco

events.name: Golden Gate Park Band Free Concerts
events.dates_2026: 144th season: Sundays 1pm, Apr 26-Sep 27, 2026, plus July 4 and Labor Day
events.location: Spreckels Temple of Music (Bandshell), Music Concourse, Golden Gate Park
events.organizer: Golden Gate Park Band (founded 1882; SF Legacy Organization)
events.notes: San Francisco's oldest musical organization, performing free concerts since 1882.

events.name: Downtown First Thursdays (DFT)
events.location: Second Street between Market & Howard, plus neighboring alleys
events.notes: Free monthly street party with DJs, live music, drag, and performances.

events.name: SOMA Nights
events.dates_2026: Monthly on Folsom Street (6th-12th Sts), evenings
events.source_name: SOMA Nights (official site, linked from SF Travel guides)
events.notes: Art, food and culture festival with pop-ups (7th-8th Sts) and club programming (9th-12th Sts).

events.name: Inner Sunset Flea Market
events.dates_2026: Second Sundays, April-November 2026, on Irving St between 9th & 11th Aves
events.source_name: Sunset Mercantile (official site, linked from SF Travel guides)
events.notes: Two blocks of local vendors, live music, family activities; themed monthly.

events.name: Yerba Buena Gardens Festival
events.dates_2026: May-November 2026; nearly 100 free artistic, cultural and community events
events.notes: Includes music series, cultural festivals, dance, theater and spoken word.

events.name: Fridays on Front Street
events.dates_2026: Select Fridays, 2026 season (live music curated by Noise Pop, food pop-ups, games)
flags: Exact 2026 dates not enumerated on the official page consulted.
events.notes: SF's free block party series.

events.name: Drag Me Downtown
events.dates_2026: Every Thursday in June 2026, 5-7pm, at downtown businesses
events.notes: Pride-month pop-up drag show series.

events.name: Bhangra & Beats Night Market
events.notes: Bhangra music, Bay Area music genres, food, cocktails and shopping.

events.name: Pop-Ups on the Plaza (Foodwise maker markets)
events.dates_2026: 2026 editions: Mar 28 (BIPOC Women Makers), Jun 7 (Juneteenth on the Waterfront, 6th annual), Oct 3 (Latine Makers)
events.location: Embarcadero Ferry Terminal Plaza / Ferry Plaza Farmers Market
events.notes: Free community maker markets in front of the Ferry Building.

events.name: Circus Bella: Circus in the Parks (HOOPLA!)
events.dates_2026: Summer 2026, free performances at parks across San Francisco
flags: Individual 2026 performance dates not enumerated on the official page consulted.
events.notes: Free one-ring circus with acrobats, aerialists, jugglers, clowns and live band.
